description: The smallest callable literal: `lambda { 1 }` desugars to `send none "lambda" [] (block [] [] (int 1))` -- no new Expr head, just a send whose `blk` child is a block with no params. The type belongs to the *block* node and is an arrow spine with no params, arrow_of([], Int); `f.call` then eliminates it. (This is the same program the umbrella project's J31 semantic-axiom pilot uses.)
